report_name: NIST Finalizes Guidelines to Protect Digital Identity and Access Tokens

identities.name: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
identities.description: The U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) has published its final guidelines for securing digital identity and access tokens, including new considerations for securing AI systems and migrating to post-quantum cryptography (PQC).

identities.name: Joint Cyber Defense Collaborative
identities.description: Collaborated with NIST on the development of the access token protection guidance.

identities.name: Cloud Service Providers (CSPs)
identities.description: A key target audience for the NIST guidance, responsible for building and securing identity platforms that mint and validate tokens.

identities.name: U.S. Federal Agencies
identities.description: A key target audience for the NIST guidance, as major consumers of cloud services.

identities.name: Microsoft Exchange Online
identities.description: Mentioned as an example of a cloud environment that was compromised by attackers using forged access tokens.

relationships.source_name: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
